book5EndingSequence: Floor 6 Masquerade finale transfers castle and qualifying occupants to Floor 9; Carl remains on Floor 6 for the bramble-crater battle.
Book 5 epilogue enters Floor 7; the Great Race shatters and crawlers enter the Floor 8 selection chamber.
scope.description: Source-supported location and route survey through Books 1–8, including Ghosts of Earth on Floor 8, Faction Wars on Floor 9, racing on Floor 10 and the Parade of Horribles on Floor 11. Six new modular environment families extend the Book 1–5 library; these are artistic adaptations, not exact canonical floorplans or an exhaustive concordance.

coverageGaps: Research is not a full-text audit or complete canonical atlas; entries reflect the three scoped research files and their cited sources.

The Iron Tangle has hundreds of stations and many named color routes. Route variants reuse Iron Tangle track/station/train kits rather than imply distinct architectural sets; individual crawler visitation remains mixed or unresolved.

Train Yard A is disputed and should not be depicted as a confirmed visited yard. Yard M is supported only by tertiary discussion and needs primary-text review; the combined yard entry is marked for review.
Amaranth and Pink route names are reader-reported candidates, not included among the researched location entries; verify against the novel before adding.
Book 4 references to Larracos describe remote effects on Floor 9. Its coverage uses broadcast/remote-view art and does not authorize playable Floor 9 maps.
Book 5 visual specifics for some settlements and the CrawlCon Studio rely on secondary or companion sources; confidence and notes preserve those limits.
Generic or unnamed settlements, safe rooms, stations, and bubble environments are consolidated into reusable kits instead of being invented as separate named locations.
Inventory tiles are normalized PNG art adaptations, not native game-engine assets; they have no runtime integration.
Some individual venue interiors and train-yard labels have weaker source support than their parent location; their records are marked review-needed even when a reusable tile kit is available.
Book 5 enters Floor 7 and the Floor 8 selection chamber in the epilogue. The actual Floor 8 destination is unidentified, so do not illustrate a Bahamas, Cuba, or other island landscape as visited.

Book 4 Larracos references remain remote. In Book 5 the castle and qualifying occupants transfer to Floor 9, while the bramble-dome crater battle remains on Floor 6 before the Floor 7–8 epilogue transitions.
Secondary fan chapter indexes supply the cemetery names, college visit and most Floor 11 visual detail; these need direct prose verification for a critical edition.
The official Book 8 blurb confirms a mysterious eleventh floor but alone does not prove the parade route or arena design; detailed claims are explicitly attributed to the secondary chapter index.
No measured maps, coordinates, distances, complete race-course topology or comprehensive location concordance were established.
The Bahamas, other teams' world regions, recurring clubs and private spaces are not new dedicated kits in this size-conscious proposal. A mention or report is not treated as Carl's visit.
No Book 9 or later unpublished material is included.

sources.supports: Book 6 title, Floor 8 card contest, first publication 2023-07-02 and republication 2025-05-13.
Book 7 title, first publication 2024-11-03, Floor 9 Faction Wars and the central castle objective.
Book 8 title and publication 2026-05-12; Floor 10 vehicle races and upgrades; Floor 11 is named in the synopsis.
The author announced Book 8 available on 2026-05-12, rather than merely scheduled.
Published hardcover on 2026-05-12, 704 pages; corroborates title, series number and race premise.

Chapter 1 enters Floor 8 at El Capitolio in Havana. The room has colored tile, arched windows and lamps. Later sample pages enter Old Havana and describe city traffic and a route toward Miramar near the northern coast.

Chapter 1 enters Larracos on Floor 9. Recently drained low streets have mud, pitted stone buildings, water-damaged wooden doors and a broken railing. The city is funnel-shaped; Shanty Town is a separate ring.
Colón Cemetery becomes the corrupted town Pueblo de los Olvidados. The chapter index names La Iglesia de los Olvidados / Temple of Yemaya and a spirit-box trap.
Carl and Donut arrive in drained Larracos; the city's defenders and defense system are part of Faction Wars.
The party visits the Larracos College of Magic and meets War Leader Arief.
Carl arrives in a Floor 10 garage, with a garage manager and vehicle selection.
The Floor 11 procession assembles themed vehicles and mounts, decorates with dahlias, and moves toward a staging area.
The Floor 11 parade proceeds along a yellow-brick road with fog at the sides and masked onlookers.
The parade reaches a large white arena door. Inside are packed dirt, spectator bleachers, a white tree landmark and a large display used for an announcement.
The late Book 8 arena is an active narrative location where vehicles and combatants enter the finale.
